verses.1: And he made the statue of Nebuchadnezzar: it was forty cubits in length, forty cubits in width, and ten cubits in height.
verses.2: And he made the sea to be divided into twelve parts, from one side of it to the other. There were also five parts where the sea was stilled, and thirty parts where it flowed around.
verses.3: And in the mornings, they are surrounded by twelve miles of sea around them. In the mornings, they are covered with waves.
verses.4: It stands on twelve feet, with three sides facing north and south, and three sides facing east and west. The sea covers all of them from above.
verses.5: And his lips were like the lips of a blooming flower; they could hold three thousand people in their embrace.
verses.6: And he made twelve basins. He gave five of them to Aaron and his sons, so that they could use them for washing their hands before performing their rituals. The sea was also used as a basin for the priests to wash in.
verses.7: And he made the golden lamps according to their measurements. He placed five on the right side of the temple, and five on the left side.
verses.8: And he made twelve pillars. He placed five of them in the temple, and five in Shechem. He also made twenty golden censers.
verses.9: And he built the courtyard for the priests, as well as the large support structures and doors for their use. The doors were made of precious materials.
verses.10: And the sea was given from the breast of the sea itself, above the north side.
verses.11: And Huraam did the work of making the vessels, the containers, and the other items needed for the service. Huraam was able to carry out the tasks that Solomon had assigned to him in the Temple of God.
verses.12: There are two pillars, and there are also two crowns and caps placed on top of those pillars. These crowns and caps serve to cover up the two crowns that are located on top of the pillars.
verses.13: And for the four columns, there are two rows of columns. Two rows of columns serve to cover the two panels that are located on the faces of the idols.
verses.14: And he made the poles, and he also made the wheels on top of the poles.
verses.15: One sea, and two dozen days of morning beneath it.
verses.16: And he made the altars, the vessels, and all their utensils for the Temple of Jehovah. They were made by Huram, his father, for King Solomon.
verses.17: In the valley of Jehudah, the king dug out a canal through the land, between its hills and valleys.
verses.18: And Solomon did all these dishes in great quantity, because the scale used to measure them wasn’t accurate enough.
verses.19: And Solomon did all the utensils that were in the Temple of God. He also made the golden altar and the sacred vessels, and he placed bread on them.
verses.20: And the lamps and their wicks shall be extinguished, as a judgment before this Judge, who is like gold in its purity.
verses.21: And the flowers, the fruits, and the precious objects are all made of gold.
verses.22: And the gold doors and windows, as well as the chests and containers, were all sealed and unlocked. The inner doors of the house were dedicated to the sacred things, while the doors of the house itself were dedicated to the golden rooms.
